Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
nullchk;
declare
 s_code_desc varchar2(250);
begin 
 select code_desc
 into s_code_desc
 from valid_test_results vtr, master_codes mc
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 and result_status = :test_intp
 and mc.code = result_status
 and code_type = 'RESUL'
 and plate_seq = 'I' -- Added by Kishore on 05/12/2011. IM 5455
 and sysdate between vtr.eff_date and nvl(vtr.term_date,sysdate)
 and sysdate between mc.eff_date and nvl(mc.term_date,sysdate);
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1201');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/12/2011. IM 5455
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT') or 
 :org_val != :eff_date 
 THEN
 IF trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(v_local_time) -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/12/2011. IM 5455
 THEN
 show_error('8044');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF :term_date is not NULL and
 trunc(:eff_date) > trunc(:term_date)
 THEN
 next_item;
 show_error('8045');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 if trunc(v_local_time) > :term_date THEN -- Changed "sysdate" to "v_local_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/12/2011
 next_item;
 show_error('3115');
 end if; 
EXCEPTION
 when value_error then
 show_error('0022','DD-MON-YYYY');
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP

declare

begin
 IF :system.record_status not in ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 WHEN_LEAVING_RECORD('UP');
 IF cur_stat != 'NEW' and :system.cursor_record != '1' THEN
 PREVIOUS_RECORD;
 END IF;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_GROUP_BAND_NAME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CREATE_GROUP_BAND_NAME IS
 rg_id recordgroup;
 cl_id groupcolumn;
 cur_item varchar2(40);
 ctr number(2) := 0;
BEGIN
 rg_id := find_group('BAND_NAMES');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(rg_id);
 END IF;
 rg_id := create_group('BAND_NAMES');
 cl_id := add_group_column(rg_id,'BAND_NM',CHAR_COLUMN,6); 
 cur_item := :system.cursor_item; 
 go_block('valid_test_bands');
 first_record;
 loop
 ctr := ctr + 1;
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(rg_id, END_OF_GROUP);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(cl_id,ctr,:band_name);
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 go_item(cur_item); 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_MATRIX_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE INSERT_MATRIX_DETAILS IS
 item_prefix varchar2(30) := 'VALID_BAND_MATRIX_HEADER.RES';
 item_value varchar2(4);
 band_nm varchar2(6);
BEGIN
 for i in 1 .. :band_count
 loop
 item_value := name_in(item_prefix || lpad(to_char(i),2,'0'));
 IF item_value is not null 
 THEN
 band_nm := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('BAND_NAMES.BAND_NM',i);
 INSERT INTO valid_test_band_matrix_detail 
 (test_id, set_number, band_name, band_value)
 VALUES
 (:ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id, :valid_band_matrix_header.set_number,
 band_nm, item_value); 
 END IF;
 end loop; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FETCH_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE FETCH_DETAILS IS
 CURSOR C1 is 
 SELECT band_name, band_value 
 FROM valid_test_band_matrix_detail
 WHERE set_number = :set_number;
 item_prefix varchar2(40) := 'VALID_BAND_MATRIX_HEADER.RES';
 item_number number(2);
 no_of_recs number(3) := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('VALID_RECS');
BEGIN
 ADD_GROUP_ROW('VALID_RECS',END_OF_GROUP);
 no_of_recs := nvl(no_of_recs,0) + 1; 
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('VALID_RECS.SET_NO',no_of_recs,:set_number);
 for fet in C1
 loop
 item_number := 0;
 for i in 1.. :band_count
 loop
 IF fet.band_name = GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('BAND_NAMES.BAND_NM',i)
 THEN
 item_number := i;
 exit;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 IF item_number != 0 THEN
 copy(fet.band_value, item_prefix || lpad(to_char(item_number),2,'0'));
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL
 ('VALID_RECS.RES'|| lpad(to_char(item_number),2,'0'), no_of_recs,fet.band_value);
 END IF;
 end loop; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_DETAILS IS
 item_name varchar2(40);
 item_value varchar2(4);
 org_band_value varchar2(6);
 band_nm varchar2(6);
BEGIN
 for i in 1 .. :band_count
 loop
 band_nm := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('BAND_NAMES.BAND_NM',i);
 item_name := 'VALID_BAND_MATRIX_HEADER.RES' || lpad(to_char(i),2,'0');
 item_value := name_in(item_name);
 BEGIN
 SELECT band_name 
 INTO org_band_value
 FROM valid_test_band_matrix_detail
 WHERE set_number = :set_number
 AND band_name = band_nm;
 IF item_value IS NULL THEN
 DELETE valid_test_band_matrix_detail
 WHERE set_number = :set_number
 AND band_name = band_nm;
 ELSIF org_band_value != item_value THEN
 UPDATE valid_test_band_matrix_detail
 SET band_value = item_value
 WHERE set_number = :set_number
 AND band_name = band_nm;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 IF item_value is not null THEN
 INSERT INTO valid_test_band_matrix_detail 
 (test_id, set_number, band_name, band_value)
 VALUES
 (:ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id, :valid_band_matrix_header.set_number,
 band_nm, item_value); 
 END IF;
 END;
 end loop; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUPLICATE_RECORD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHECK_DUPLICATE_RECORD 
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 count_recs number(3) := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('VALID_RECS');
 t_num varchar2(2);
 dup_rec varchar2(1) := 'Y';
BEGIN
 IF count_recs = 0 THEN
 return FALSE;
 END IF;
 for x in 1 .. count_recs
 loop
 for i in 1 .. :band_count 
 loop
 dup_rec := 'Y';
 t_num := lpad(to_char(i),2,'0');
 IF nvl(name_in('VALID_BAND_MATRIX_HEADER.RES' || t_num),'XNULLX') !=
 nvl(GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('VALID_RECS.RES' || t_num, x), 'XNULLX') 
 THEN
 dup_rec := 'N';
 exit;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 IF dup_rec = 'Y' THEN 
 IF nvl(:set_number,9999999) = 
 GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('VALID_RECS.SET_NO', x)
 THEN
 dup_rec := 'N';
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 exit when dup_rec = 'Y';
 end loop;
 IF dup_rec = 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 ELSE
 return FALSE;
 END IF; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: WHEN_LEAVING_RECORD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE WHEN_LEAVING_RECORD (t_mode in varchar2) IS
-- t_MODE will contain what action has the procedure been called with - UP or DOWN
BEGIN
 IF :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED') THEN
 IF :test_intp is null and :eff_date is null and :term_date is null
 and t_mode = 'UP'
 THEN
 clear_record;
 ELSE
 validate_record;
 check_package_failure;
 IF check_duplicate_record THEN
 show_error('1033');
 END IF;
 ADD_UPDATE_RG;
 :system.message_level := '5';
 post;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 END IF;
 ELSIF :system.record_status = 'NEW' THEN
 clear_record;
 ELSIF :system.record_status = 'QUERY' THEN 
 null;
 END IF; 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADD_UPDATE_RG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ADD_UPDATE_RG IS
 r_count number(3);
 t_num varchar2(2);
 cur_row number(3);
BEGIN
 IF :system.record_status = 'INSERT' THEN
 ADD_GROUP_ROW('VALID_RECS',END_OF_GROUP);
 r_count := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('VALID_RECS'); 
 FOR i in 1.. :band_count
 loop
 t_num := lpad(to_char(i),2,'0');
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('VALID_RECS.RES' || t_num, r_count,
 name_in('VALID_BAND_MATRIX_HEADER.RES'|| t_num));
 end loop;
 BEGIN
 IF :set_number is null THEN
 SELECT test_band_seq.nextval
 INTO :set_number
 FROM dual;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('VALID_RECS.SET_NO',r_count,:set_number); 
 ELSIF :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' THEN
 r_count := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('VALID_RECS'); 
 for x in 1 .. r_count
 loop
 cur_row := x;
 exit when 
 :set_number = GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('VALID_RECS.SET_NO',x);
 end loop;
 IF :set_number != GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('VALID_RECS.SET_NO',cur_row)
 THEN
 show_error('1098');
 ELSE
 FOR i in 1.. :band_count
 loop
 t_num := lpad(to_char(i),2,'0');
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('VALID_RECS.RES' || t_num, r_count,
 name_in('VALID_BAND_MATRIX_HEADER.RES'|| t_num));
 end loop;
 END IF;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISPLAY_BANDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE display_bands IS
 gap number(1);
 res_width number(1);
 item_prefix varchar2(40) := 'VALID_BAND_MATRIX_HEADER.RES';
 item_prefixlh VARCHAR2 (40) := 'CTRL_BLK_1.LHDR';
 item_prefixh VARCHAR2 (40) := 'CTRL_BLK_1.HDR';
 v_hdr VARCHAR2 (50);
 v_disp2 VARCHAR2 (25);
 v_disp1 VARCHAR2 (25);
 item_name varchar2(50);
 item_xpos number(2);
 rg_id recordgroup;
 cl_id groupcolumn; 
 col_nm varchar2(10); 
begin
 CREATE_GROUP_BAND_NAME;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('dummy01', displayed, property_false);

 IF :band_count <= 5
 THEN
 gap := 9;
 res_width := 8;
 ELSIF :band_count > 5 AND :band_count <= 7
 THEN
 gap := 6;
 res_width := 5;
 ELSIF :band_count > 7 AND :band_count <= 9
 THEN
 gap := 5;
 res_width := 4;
 ELSIF :band_count > 9 AND :band_count <= 11
 THEN
 gap := 4;
 res_width := 3;
 ELSIF :band_count > 11
 THEN
 gap := 3;
 res_width := 2;
 END IF;

 GO_BLOCK ('valid_test_bands');

 IF :band_count > 7
 THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.display1 := NULL;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY ('CTRL_BLK_1.display1', displayed, property_false);
 END IF;

 FOR x IN 1 .. :band_count
 LOOP
 GO_RECORD (x);
 item_name := item_prefixlh || LPAD (TO_CHAR (x), 2, '0');
 v_hdr := item_prefixh || LPAD (TO_CHAR (x), 2, '0');

 IF :band_count <= 7
 THEN
 v_disp2 := :valid_test_bands.band_name;
 v_disp1 := NULL;
 --:display2 := :display2 || rpad(:valid_test_bands.band_name,gap+12,'_');
 ELSE
 IF NVL (LENGTH (:band_name), 0) < 4
 THEN
 IF NVL (LENGTH (:band_name), 0) <= res_width
 THEN
 v_disp2 := :valid_test_bands.band_name;
 v_disp1 := NULL;
 --:display1 := rpad(nvl(:display1,'_'),NVL(length(:display1), 0) + gap+7.5, '_');
 --:display2 := :display2 || rpad(:band_name, gap+5, '_');
 ELSE
 IF NVL (LENGTH (:band_name), 0) =
 NVL (LENGTH (RTRIM (:band_name, '1234567890')), 0)
 THEN
 v_disp2 := SUBSTR (:band_name, res_width + 1);
 v_disp1 := SUBSTR (:band_name, 1, res_width);
 --:display1 := :display1 || rpad(substr(:band_name,1,res_width),gap+1,'_');
 --:display2 := :display2 || rpad(substr(:band_name,res_width+1),gap+1,'_');
 ELSE
 v_disp2 :=
 SUBSTR (:band_name,
 - ( NVL (LENGTH (:band_name), 0)
 - NVL (LENGTH (RTRIM (:band_name,
 '1234567890')
 ),
 0
 )
 )
 );
 v_disp1 := RTRIM (:band_name, '1234567890');
 --:display1 := :display1 || rpad(rtrim(:band_name,'1234567890'),gap+1,'_');
 /*--:display2 := :display2 || rpad(substr(:band_name,
 -(NVL(length(:band_name), 0) - NVL(length(rtrim(:band_name,'1234567890')
 ), 0))),gap+1,'_'); */
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NVL (LENGTH (:band_name), 0) = 4
 THEN
 v_disp2 := SUBSTR (:band_name, -2);
 v_disp1 := SUBSTR (:band_name, 1, 2);
 --:display1 := :display1 || rpad(substr(:band_name,1,2),gap+2,'_');
 --:display2 := :display2 || rpad(substr(:band_name,-2),gap+2,'_');
 ELSIF NVL (LENGTH (:band_name), 0) > 4
 THEN
 v_disp2 := SUBSTR (:band_name, -3);
 v_disp1 :=
 SUBSTR (:band_name, 1, NVL (LENGTH (:band_name), 0) - 3);
 --:display1 := :display1 || rpad(substr(:band_name,1,NVL(length(:band_name), 0)-3),gap+1,'_');
 --:display2 := :display2 || rpad(substr(:band_name,-3),gap+1,'_');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 item_xpos := 3 + ((x - 1) * (res_width + 1));
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, displayed, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, enabled, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, width, res_width * 7);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, x_pos, item_xpos * 7);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (v_hdr, displayed, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (v_hdr, enabled, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (v_hdr, width, res_width * 7);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (v_hdr, x_pos, item_xpos * 7);
 COPY (v_disp2, item_name);
 COPY (v_disp1, v_hdr);
 END LOOP;

 --BEGIN
 --:display1 := translate(:display1,'_',' ');
 --:display2 := translate(:display2,'_',' ');
 --END;
 GO_ITEM ('ctrl_blk_1.s_type');

 FOR i IN 1 .. :band_count
 LOOP
 item_name := item_prefix || LPAD (TO_CHAR (i), 2, '0');
 item_xpos := 3 + ((i - 1) * (res_width + 1));
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, displayed, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, enabled, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, navigable, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, insert_allowed, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, updateable, property_true);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, width, res_width * 7);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY (item_name, x_pos, item_xpos * 7);
 END LOOP;
 rg_id := find_group('VALID_RECS');
 IF NOT ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(rg_id);
 END IF;
 rg_id := create_group('VALID_RECS');
 for i in 1 .. :band_count
 loop
 col_nm := 'RES' || lpad(to_char(i),2,'0');
 cl_id := add_group_column(rg_id,col_nm,CHAR_COLUMN,4);
 end loop;
 cl_id := add_group_column(rg_id,'SET_NO',NUMBER_COLUMN);
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_type');
 
END;
